relations.reading: Capacity estimates can be strengthened by grading the evidence behind each automation counterfactual.

relations.title: Evidencia de contribución
relations.reading: Diamond Inside opportunities can be described more precisely by separating technical contribution, current recognition and the route through which value might actually be realized.

relations.title: Revaloración antes de clarificar
relations.reading: Diamond Inside's value-discovery proposition can be examined through the revaluation-before-clarification hypothesis without treating a potential opportunity as realized financial value.

relations.title: Migración y capitalización de capacidad
relations.reading: The survivor lens sharpens value discovery: identify the useful capability and its carriers before deciding which legacy form should remain, change or disappear.

relations.title: Custodia institucional
relations.reading: Diamond Inside offers a possible selection lens for stewardship: preserve the useful capability while deciding separately whether its original implementation should remain local, change or retire.

relations.title: Capacidad reutilizable
relations.reading: The pre-SaaS note can connect modular delivery with the reported operating-value loop, while keeping released resources distinct from independently verified net returns.

relations.title: Existencia, encuentro y oportunidad ejecutable
relations.reading: Evidence that a useful capability exists may justify a bounded search, while discovery, ownership, scale-up permission and realized value remain separate questions.

relations.title: Suficiencia para una decisión
relations.reading: A value opportunity becomes actionable through its relevance to a declared objective and an admissible transition, rather than through uncertainty reduction alone.

relations.title: Autoridad de decisión
relations.reading: Event intelligence may reveal a valuable opportunity while action remains outside the current mandate; preserving the finding and authorizing the campaign are separate steps.

relations.title: Distinciones suficientes para una pregunta nueva
relations.reading: Knowing enough to classify a capability and establishing a positive net gain are independent tasks; both should be qualified before a scale-up decision.
